dedupeText: retro futurist sci fi soundtrack cover art deco robot gynoid radial light rays chrome texture 1980s sci fi futurism the robot s golden chrome reflects the radiating blue light rays the sharp jagged title lettering mimics the verticality of the background rays the warm gold of the subject contrasts sharply with the cool blue environment symmetrical composition with the subject centered and text flanking the sides combine art deco futurism with 1980s airbrush techniques utilizing a high contrast triad of gold blue and red with sharp aggressive display typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A central golden metallic gynoid figure against a dark blue background with radiating light beams, topped by aggressive, sharp-angled custom lettering in red with metallic gradients.
coreVisualRelationships: The robot's golden chrome reflects the radiating blue light rays.
The sharp, jagged title lettering mimics the verticality of the background rays.
The warm gold of the subject contrasts sharply with the cool blue environment.
Symmetrical composition with the subject centered and text flanking the sides.
coreInvariants: Golden metallic surface with high-contrast specular highlights
Sharp, dagger-like letterforms for the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A golden robot bust occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered and facing forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The robot's face and the large, red title text above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the sharp title, move down the central robot figure, then outward along the radial blue rays to the supporting text on the left and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark blue voids between the light rays provide depth and separation for the foreground elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue and electric blue for the background and light rays.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Polished gold and brass tones for the central figure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red with orange gradients for the primary title and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright metallic highlights and the dark background; high saturation in the red title.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to gold, blue, and red primary triads

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric Sans-Serif with extreme vertical elongation
letterConstructionRules: Vertical strokes terminate in sharp, needle-like points
Horizontal bars are minimized or angled
Circular forms like 'O' and 'P' are perfectly round to contrast the sharp verticality
Heavy use of 3D beveling and internal gradients
characterSpecificRedesigns: M and S feature exaggerated, descending sharp points
The 'O' is a perfect ring with a central highlight

composition.position: Top third, arched over the subject

treatment.outline: Thin white or light blue glow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive custom display type paired with clean, functional sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: The sharp, needle-like points are unique to the 80s airbrush style and not found in standard fonts.
Geometric, futuristic sans-serifs that can be modified for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a golden metallic female robot bust in an Art Deco style. The background should be dark navy blue with electric blue radial light rays emanating from behind the robot's head. High-contrast chrome reflections on the robot's surface.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, arched title at the top using custom sharp-edged lettering with a red-to-orange metallic gradient. Place columns of small red sans-serif text on the left and right sides of the robot's torso.

verificationChecks: Are the letter terminals sharp and needle-like?
Is the robot's surface rendered with high-gloss metallic reflections?
Do the blue rays radiate symmetrically from the center?
Is the color palette strictly blue, gold, and red?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue radial rays
Level of 'wear' or grain on the airbrush texture
Degree of arch in the main title
Complexity of the robot's facial features
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting between the robot and the rays.
Ensure the red text is legible against the blue background.
Verify the 3D beveling on the main title is consistent.
Confirm the symmetry of the overall layout.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine Art Deco futurism with 1980s airbrush techniques, utilizing a high-contrast triad of gold, blue, and red with sharp, aggressive display typography.
